page_description

Which human phenotypes are relevant to my mouse phenotype?

Explore genetic correlations between mouse and human phenotypes not just based on similar descriptions, but through shared genetic associations. Using PIGEAN, a new statistical approach, this module identifies human phenotypes that are linked to mouse phenotypes via GWAS and Orphanet data.
